question.text:
What is the output of the following code?

#include <stdio.h>

void fun(int n) {
    if (n == 0)
        return;

    fun(n - 1);
    printf("%d ", n);
}

int main() {
    fun(4);
    return 0;
}
  1. $\texttt{4\ 3\ 2\ 1}$
     
  2. $\texttt{1\ 2\ 3\ 4}$
     
  3. $\texttt{0\ 1\ 2\ 3\ 4}$
     
  4. $\texttt{4\ 3\ 2\ 1\ 0}$

question.text:
What is the output of the following code?

#include <stdio.h>

int sum(int n) {
    if (n == 1)
        return 1;

    return n + sum(n - 1);
}

int main() {
    printf("%d", sum(5));
    return 0;
}

question.text:
What is the output of the following code?

#include <stdio.h>

int fact(int n) {
    if (n == 0)
        return 1;

    return n * fact(n - 1);
}

int main() {
    printf("%d", fact(4));
    return 0;
}

question.text:
What is the output of the following code?

#include <stdio.h>

int fun(int n) {
    static int count = 0;

    if (n == 0)
        return count;

    count = count + n;
    return fun(n - 1);
}

int main() {
    printf("%d", fun(3));
    return 0;
}
